import json
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Load posts data
with open('json/posts.json', 'r') as f:
    posts_data = json.load(f)
posts_df = pd.DataFrame(posts_data['records'])

# Aggregate by OwnerUserId
user_stats = posts_df.groupby('OwnerUserId').agg(
    post_count=('Id', 'count'),
    total_score=('Score', 'sum')
).reset_index()

# Filter to users with more than 10 posts
filtered_users = user_stats[user_stats['post_count'] > 10]

# Calculate up votes per post for each user
filtered_users['upvotes_per_post'] = filtered_users['total_score'] / filtered_users['post_count']

# Average up votes per post across all qualifying users
avg_upvotes_per_post = filtered_users['upvotes_per_post'].mean()

# Now load user data from SQLite to get ages
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/users.db')
users_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT Id, Age FROM users WHERE Id IN ({})".format(','.join(map(str, filtered_users['OwnerUserId'].tolist()))), conn)
conn.close()

# Merge to get ages for users with >10 posts
merged = filtered_users.merge(users_df, left_on='OwnerUserId', right_on='Id', how='left')

# Calculate average age (excluding nulls)
avg_age = merged['Age'].mean()

print(f"Average up votes per post: {avg_upvotes_per_post}")
print(f"Average user age: {avg_age}")
print(f"\nNumber of users with >10 posts: {len(filtered_users)}")
print(f"Users with non-null age: {merged['Age'].notna().sum()}")
